newsitem.title: UK: Spill-over sentiment boosts palm oil in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Spill-over sentiment boosts palm oil in Europe.

text.p: Palm oil prices on the European vegetable oil market opened higher on Wednesday, mainly on spill-over sentiment from the Malaysian market.
"Our prices have mainly followed those in the Far East, but we are seeing some interest among buyers, but not has happen yet,' said a trader.
One early trade was reported in crude palm oil when Feb fetched $565 a tonne cif.
Opening sellers were $7.50 above Tuesday's close.
Lauric oils opened unchanged to $5 up, but business was slow to start.
In soft oils soy oil started 0.50 to one guilder up while rape oil was 1.50 to 1.75 guilders higher in so far tradeless markets.
